text: Captured pixels, CSS definitions and media bytes establish different facts. A canvas tag does not establish WebGL, and none of them establishes recovered JavaScript or React behavior.

Reuse supported source CSS/media when it survives custody and works. Otherwise use supported platform interaction, or the governed custom-component ladder for a concrete unmet behavior. … If the behavior remains unavailable, preserve its meaning with an explicit equivalent or compact static fallback, removing dead height and unreachable content.
Never replay arbitrary source scripts or bypass a sandbox, missing-asset refusal, or compiler restriction.
Static screenshots cannot prove a video advances, an animation loops, or a visitor can operate a control. … Keep unobserved behavior unverified.

Choose a visible, usable reduced-motion state for every moving region. Essential copy, product content and CTAs stay accessible with motion stopped and at mobile widths. Source reveal classes must not strand content at opacity zero.

Treat a product switcher as one linked component: selecting each card must change its associated product view and active state. … Reconstruct a supported interaction or present the material as visibly static, ordered content without dead controls.
1. Supported source reuse … 2. Supported equivalent (dialog, accordion, marquee, nav menu, carousel, tabs) … 3. Governed custom component, when lower rungs fail … 4. Compact static fallback
note: Site: making-a-section-interactive covers rung 3 on live sites.

text: Do not introduce sound autoplay. Where motion is decorative, a visible poster/static state is a suitable reduced-motion target; where video communicates essential information, keep controls and an equivalent readable explanation.
Record each observed control, its visible text, selected treatment and matching registered asset. … do not invent a fourth capability just because the source has four cards.

Video: verify the actual media loads and decodes, time/frames advance, and the observed view is not just its poster. … Tabs, carousel and accordion: activate visible controls, verify the selected content changes …
note: Site render_page gives two still screenshots only.
